content.content:
Validation result: PARTIAL FAILURE — 2 of 3 fixes verified, 1 still broken.

## What passes
- Phase 3 'displays empty state when no comments': ✅ PASS (copy now matches 'No comments yet' + 'Be the first to add a comment')
- Phase 3 'adds a comment via the form': ✅ PASS
- Implementation files (Header.tsx, CommentsSection.tsx) were NOT changed — confirmed via git, only the test files were modified. Good.

## What still fails (real bug in the fix)
- Phase 1 'renders the agentrack header': ❌ STILL FAILING, in isolation too (not flaky).

Root cause: the assertion at phase1-validation.spec.ts:42 uses a substring regex:
```ts
const header = page.getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i });
```
This resolves to 3 elements (strict-mode violation) because issue list links whose titles contain 'agentrack' also match (e.g. 'Webapp: Build the agentrack...'). Playwright error:
> strict mode violation: getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i }) resolved to 3 elements

The developer's claim of '59/59 pass' does not reproduce — my run of phase1+phase3 shows 57 passed / 2 failed. The regex fix is data-dependent and fragile.

Suggested correct fix (for whoever reopens mqe06bbvql):
- Option A (preferred): scope to the header landmark — `page.locator('header').getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i })`
- Option B: exact string match — `page.getByRole('link', { name: 'agentrack', exact: true })`

## Other notes
- The 2nd failure in the combined run ('sets a parent via search and selection') is NOT one of the 3 target tests and PASSES in isolation → known flaky test (PM epic mqdzlo4ia8), not a regression.

Recommend reopening the fix task (mqe06bbvql) with the correction above. Validation will need to be re-run once the phase1 assertion is fixed.

content.content:
Validation PASSED — all 3 target tests now pass.

## What was verified
- ✅ Phase 1 'renders the agentrack header': PASS (scoped to header landmark via page.locator('header').getByRole(...) — strict-mode violation resolved)
- ✅ Phase 3 'displays empty state when no comments': PASS
- ✅ Phase 3 'adds a comment via the form': PASS
- ✅ Combined phase1 + phase3 run: 59/59 PASS (9.3s)

## Implementation unchanged (test-only fix confirmed)
- Verified via git diff: packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/**/Header.tsx and CommentsSection.tsx have ZERO changes from HEAD.
- The phase1 fix (Option A from the validator report) only modifies e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts:44-46 — adding .locator('header') scoping.
- The fix matches the recommended Option A (scope to header landmark) over the regex exact-match alternative.

## No regressions from the fix
- Full suite: 170 passed / 4 failed (46.2s).
- The 4 failures are ALL in phase4 BUG-2 sync tests (expect 500, now receive 200) — these are NOT caused by this task's test-only changes. phase4-validation.spec.ts is unchanged from HEAD, and the sync behavior change is independent of the phase1/phase3 assertion fixes.
- The phase3 flaky test 'sets a parent via search and selection' (which failed in the prior validation run's combined run) PASSES both in the combined phase1+phase3 run AND in isolation — no regression there.

## Out-of-scope discovery (logged separately)
The 4 phase4 sync test failures are deterministic (not flaky — confirmed via isolation re-run). They assert known-buggy BUG-2 behavior (500 NOT_INITIALIZED) but the endpoints now return 200, suggesting BUG-2 was fixed elsewhere, leaving stale tests. Created idea mqgxtlb8cl for the project-manager to triage — these tests need updating to reflect the current (working) sync behavior, or the sync implementation needs investigation if the 200 is itself incorrect.

## Conclusion
The phase1 header assertion fix is correct and robust — it eliminates the data-dependent fragility of the unscoped regex without weakening the assertion's intent (still verifies the brand link is visible). Validation succeeds; this task is complete.
